note: Case manifest for the Morgan naturalness suite. Audio lives in clips/ and reference/ (gitignored, voice data); this manifest carries no audio and no transcript text. source is 'morgan' for session recordings and 'reference_avm' for AVM references (the metrics CLI stamps it into each case's JSON and the report splits its tables on it). lever_state is null for reference_avm cases; for Morgan cases it is an object shaped as {"instructions_commit":"<short sha of the repo commit whose planner built this session's instructions>","vad":{"silence_duration_ms":900,"threshold":0.6,"prefix_padding_ms":300},"note":"optional free text"}. No code reads lever_state yet; this manifest documents the operator contract. held_out marks the AVM recording excluded from tuning discussions.
